header.preparing: Getting ready · nothing is being recorded yet

intro.lead: This assessment is here so we understand how you think before we meet. You complete it on your own, in your own time.
intro.step1Body: You will make a 5 second trial recording so we know your camera and microphone work. It is never sent anywhere.
intro.step2Title: You see the questions one at a time
intro.step2Body: Each question gives you thinking time first, then answering time starts. Questions are not shown in advance.
intro.step3Body: Software does not score your answers. A person watches, writes their notes and makes the decision.
intro.recordingTitle: Video and audio will be recorded
intro.recordingBody: Your video answers record your picture and voice; only the hiring team for this position sees them. They are deleted after {months} months, and you can ask for deletion at any time.
intro.consentLabel: I agree to being recorded and to my answers being reviewed for this application.
intro.consentRequired: Tick the box above to start.
intro.resumeNote: If you stop halfway you can carry on from the same link. If something goes wrong, write to <mail>{email}</mail>.

info.title: Let us get your details right
info.body: These details are only so your application reaches you. The questions start after this.

invite.subject: {position} assessment
invite.body: Hello {name}, here is your assessment link: {link}

exam.lead: {org} has invited you to a German exam. It runs entirely in your browser, nothing to install.
exam.proctoredCamera: Your camera and microphone stay on for the whole exam.
exam.proctoredFullscreen: The exam runs in full screen; switching windows or tabs is recorded.
exam.proctoredAi: Unusual moments are flagged with AI help and reviewed by your teacher. The system never fails anyone automatically.
exam.proctoredRetention: Recordings are kept for {days} days and then deleted.
exam.notProctored: This exam is not proctored. Your answers are saved.
exam.consentLabel: I have read the above and I agree.

exam.finishingIn: The section closes in {s} seconds. Remaining questions count as blank.

section.ruleGRAMMAR: Choose an option or fill the gap in each question. Questions get harder or easier with your answers.
section.ruleREADING: The text is on the left, the questions on the right. Read it as often as you like.

hiringDevice.title: Let's check your device first
hiringDevice.body: No question comes before this step, so nothing technical surprises you while you answer.
hiringDevice.cameraAsk: Your browser will ask for permission. Once you allow it, you see yourself here.
hiringDevice.micAsk: Your browser will ask for permission to use the microphone.
hiringDevice.micHint: Say a few words in your normal voice.
hiringDevice.trialBody: Make a 5 second test recording and play it back. Repeat as often as you like. This recording is not sent anywhere.
hiringDevice.connLow: {mbps} Mbps upload · low. Move closer to the Wi-Fi if you can; recordings still upload, a little later.
hiringDevice.connUnknown: Could not measure it. You can still go on.
hiringDevice.deniedOther: We could not reach the camera or microphone. Another app may be using it.
hiringDevice.fixchrome:
Click the icon left of the address bar, choose Allow for Camera and Microphone, then reload the page.
Still not working? Your computer must allow it too: on macOS System Settings > Privacy & Security > Camera and Microphone, on Windows Settings > Privacy > Camera and Microphone; allow your browser.
hiringDevice.fixsafariMac:
In the Safari menu open Settings for This Website, choose Allow for Camera and Microphone, then reload.
Still not working? Your Mac must allow it too: on macOS System Settings > Privacy & Security > Camera and Microphone, allow Safari.
hiringDevice.fixios: In Settings > Safari > Camera and Microphone choose Allow or Ask, then come back and reload.
hiringDevice.fixandroid: Tap the lock icon in the address bar, allow Camera and Microphone under Permissions, then reload.
hiringDevice.fixfirefox:
Click the camera icon in the address bar, remove the block, then reload.
Still not working? Your computer must allow it too: on macOS System Settings > Privacy & Security > Camera and Microphone, on Windows Settings > Privacy > Camera and Microphone; allow your browser.
hiringDevice.fixother: Allow camera and microphone for this site in your browser settings, then reload.
hiringDevice.fixinApp: Open this page in Safari or Chrome: in the menu at the top right (··· or ⋮) choose Open in browser.
hiringDevice.fixiosOther: On the iPhone open Settings, find your browser (Chrome, Firefox or Edge), turn on Camera and Microphone, then come back and reload.
